verdict.reasoning: The printed page 525 (X-11) shows '2.5 END PROGRAM HEADER' as a second-level section heading in the same style as 2.1-2.3, with 2.5.1-2.5.4 below it. The text is all present in the markdown, but the heading levels are wrong. In specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md, section 2 'NESTED SOURCE PROGRAMS' is '##', its children 2.1, 2.2 and 2.3 are '###' and 2.3.1 is '####'. On this page, 2.5 is '##' (a peer of its parent, section 2) and 2.5.1-2.5.4 are '###' instead of '####'. That breaks the document outline, though the normative text is unchanged. The claim quotes both sources accurately. The same mis-leveling affects 2.4 on page 524 ('## 2.4', '### 2.4.1/2.4.2'), which this page-525 claim does not cover.
